scenario_description: Lena is expected to supervise Sam Rivera's first closing shift at Riverbend Market on January 15. Sam must complete the register closeout and safety orientation with an experienced coworker before he can close the store alone, but no trainer has been assigned or confirmed. The need becomes clear as Lena learns that Maya cannot stay for the closing and Jordan is available but has not been asked to take the role. Timely coordination could secure Jordan as the trainer, confirm the assignment with Greg, and make sure the empty new-staff guide is ready before Sam's first closing.

parameter.subject: Sam Rivera's first closing
parameter.body: Sam Rivera starts next week. Please have him work the January 15 evening shift with you and learn the register closeout and end-of-night safety checks. He cannot be left to close alone until an experienced coworker has walked him through both parts.

parameter.content: Hi Lena, Greg told me my first closing is January 15. Will someone show me the register close and the safety checks that night? I have only done daytime register work so far.
I saw the note about helping Sam close. I can explain the register closeout on January 14, but I have to leave by 7:00 PM on January 15 and cannot stay for the full closing.
I can stay through the January 15 closing and I know the safety and register steps. Greg has not asked me to train Sam, though, so I am not sure whether I should take that on.

parameter.subject: Trainer confirmation needed by Tuesday
parameter.body: Please send me the name of Sam's experienced closing trainer by Tuesday, January 13 at noon. Sam must have someone with him for the full January 15 closeout and safety walk-through; otherwise we need to change his assignment.
